scene: The spice rack labels reveal transit routes departing the bridge's edge.
picture: A flat side view of Gear Bridge's transit junction. On the far left, a window-cleaner gondola hangs by thick steel cables. To its right, the player in his orange jacket holds his soup bowl. In the centre, an open-doored silver mail train idles on rails. On the far right, a yellow tow truck rests with blinking roof lights.
